components.title: Azure OpenAI Service - GPT-4o Foundation Model
components.description: High-assurance managed cloud deployment of the OpenAI GPT-4o multimodal foundation model hosted within Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service under FedRAMP High authorization. Features Azure AI Content Safety filtering, Azure Private Link network isolation, Microsoft Entra ID authentication, Customer-Managed Keys (CMK), and compliance with the OpenAI Frontier Safety and Preparedness Framework.
components.purpose: Provide FedRAMP High authorized generative AI inference capabilities for natural language generation, reasoning, structured output synthesis, code generation, and computer vision analysis.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for Azure OpenAI GPT-4o within FedRAMP High baseline

implemented-requirements.description: Remote access to Azure OpenAI GPT-4o endpoints is strictly governed through Azure Private Link private endpoints within customer Virtual Networks (VNets), disabling all public network ingress. Management plane access is governed via Microsoft Entra ID Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with FIPS 140-2 validated MFA.

statements.description: Connection requirements enforce private IP routing over Azure Private Endpoints (privatelink.openai.azure.com) or ExpressRoute/VPN with publicNetworkAccess=Disabled. Protocols require TLS 1.2/1.3 with OAuth2 bearer token authentication via Microsoft Entra ID.
Remote access connections are pre-authorized via Azure Resource Manager private endpoint approvals and Entra ID Conditional Access policies prior to session establishment.

implemented-requirements.description: Direct wireless access to Microsoft Azure datacenter infrastructure hosting the Azure OpenAI Service is physically and logically prohibited. Any customer-side wireless connectivity must terminate at an enterprise corporate VPN/gateway prior to routing through Azure Private Link.

statements.description: Wireless networking is prohibited within datacenter hosting facilities. Client wireless connections require corporate gateway termination with 802.1X EAP-TLS before accessing Azure OpenAI endpoints.
Wireless client access to administrative management consoles requires explicit device health attestation and Entra ID Conditional Access evaluation prior to connection establishment.

implemented-requirements.description: Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel continuously ingest diagnostic logs (HTTP request/response metadata, caller Entra ID identity, token usage, latency, and Azure AI Content Safety filter events) for automated analysis, anomaly detection, and incident response.

values: continuous automated real-time stream analysis and daily security review
prompt injection attacks, jailbreak attempts, content safety policy violations, unexpected token consumption bursts, authentication failures, and unauthorized model invocation attempts
Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts and Information System Security Officer (ISSO)

statements.description: Audit records are continuously collected and analyzed via Azure Log Analytics and Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules to detect unauthorized prompts, jailbreak patterns, and anomalous API consumption.
Audit findings and high-severity content safety violation alerts are automatically reported to the SOC and ISSO via Sentinel incident alerts and automated response playbooks.
Diagnostic log verbosity and retention periods are dynamically adjusted based on system risk categorization and observed threat activity.

implemented-requirements.description: Azure Resource Graph and Azure Resource Manager maintain an automated, machine-readable inventory of all deployed Azure OpenAI accounts and GPT-4o model deployments, including snapshot version, model deprecation lifecycle status, capacity allocation, and network bindings.

values: model deployment name, base model identifier (gpt-4o), snapshot version tag, capacity type (PTU or Standard), Azure resource ID, provisioning state, content filter policy ID, private endpoint IP, and hosting Azure region
continuous automated inventory discovery via Azure Resource Graph and monthly formal baseline review

statements.description: An accurate inventory of all GPT-4o deployments is maintained in Azure Resource Manager, recording model snapshot versions, endpoint FQDNs, private IP allocations, and content filter configurations.
Inventory records are automatically updated upon resource creation/modification events and reviewed monthly to enforce lifecycle deprecation schedules for retired model versions.

implemented-requirements.description: Azure OpenAI GPT-4o access is governed via Microsoft Entra ID. Static shared API keys are disabled (disableLocalAuth: true). Workloads authenticate using Azure Managed Identities (MSI) or Entra ID Service Principals, and users authenticate with unique User Principal Names (UPNs).

values: Identity and Access Management (IAM) administrators in coordination with the ISSO
90 days of inactivity for human accounts; service principal keys rotated every 90 days or replaced with Managed Identities

statements.description: All client processes, agents, and human users accessing GPT-4o endpoints are uniquely identified by Microsoft Entra ID object GUIDs, Service Principal App IDs, or UPNs.
Identifiers are managed through centralized automated Entra ID workflows requiring supervisor approval and role-based assignment.
Entra ID prevents reuse of identifiers; deleted account identifiers are permanently retired and never reassigned.
Identifier assignments and privileged role mappings (e.g. Cognitive Services OpenAI User) are coordinated and reconciled with the ISSO.

implemented-requirements.description: Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) stored in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) provide encryption for GPT-4o stored assets (cached prompts, embeddings, fine-tuning checkpoints) with double encryption (platform AES-256 + CMK).

values: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validated Azure Key Vault Managed HSM for Customer-Managed Keys (CMK), automated annual key rotation, TLS 1.3 key exchange using NIST-approved curves, and dual-custody key destruction

statements.description: Cryptographic keys for data at rest and session security are generated and managed in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM with automated key rotation, soft-delete, and purge protection enabled.

implemented-requirements.description: Continuous runtime monitoring at the AI application layer is provided by Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields and category moderation, coupled with Azure Monitor infrastructure metrics and Sentinel SIEM security analytics.

values: detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect prompt injection (XPIA), malicious model abuse, unauthorized data exfiltration, and content policy violations
synchronous Azure AI Content Safety evaluation, Prompt Shields for user prompts and documents, Azure Monitor diagnostic streaming, and Microsoft Sentinel machine-learning anomaly detection
request URI, caller identity, prompt filter violation categories and severities, token consumption rates, and HTTP response codes
Security Operations Center (SOC) and Information System Security Officer (ISSO)
continuous real-time inspection for all inference requests and daily batch telemetry analysis

statements.description: Azure AI Content Safety synchronously monitors inference traffic to detect prompt injection attacks, jailbreaks, and policy-violating prompts in real-time.
Network Security Groups and Azure Firewall monitor connection flows and alert on unauthorized network connection attempts to the private endpoint.
Inbound prompts and outbound completions are inspected for malicious content, jailbreaks, intellectual property leakage, and prompt injection payloads before release.

implemented-requirements.description: Risk assessment for GPT-4o is conducted under the OpenAI Frontier Safety and Preparedness Framework and the Microsoft Responsible AI Standard, evaluating severe risk vectors (CBRN, cyberattack automation, persuasion, model autonomy) and FedRAMP High baseline controls.

values: OpenAI GPT-4o System Card, OpenAI Frontier Safety & Preparedness Framework Evaluation Report, and System Security Plan (SSP)
annually and prior to deploying any new model version or snapshot
Authorizing Official (AO), Information System Security Officer (ISSO), and Responsible AI Lead
annually or upon major foundation model capability updates

statements.description: Formal risk assessment evaluates potential harm from foundation model misuse across cybersecurity, CBRN, persuasion, and autonomous capabilities, establishing risk scores within allowable thresholds.
Risk assessment findings and mitigations are documented in the GPT-4o System Card, FedRAMP Security Assessment Report (SAR), and agency Risk Assessment Report.
Risk assessments are formally reviewed prior to approving new model snapshot releases and on an annual recurring schedule.
Risk evaluation reports are disseminated to the Authorizing Official (AO), ISSO, and agency AI governance committees.
The risk assessment is updated whenever new model versions, alignment patches, or multimodal capabilities are introduced.

implemented-requirements.description: Pre-deployment developer testing and evaluation leverages automated capability and safety evaluation suites, RLHF alignment validation, and expert red-teaming under the OpenAI Frontier Safety and Preparedness Framework.

values: during pre-deployment model training checkpoints, post-training alignment phases, and continuous automated regression evaluations prior to production release
automated benchmark suites across capabilities (MMLU, HumanEval, SWE-bench) and safety thresholds (Frontier Safety Preparedness Framework CBRN and cyber red teaming, HELM, SafetyBench)

statements.description: A developer testing and evaluation plan is executed encompassing post-training alignment (RLHF/DPO), safety evaluation benchmarks, and adversarial red-teaming.
Adversarial evaluations test model boundaries against automated jailbreak generation, toxic content elicitation, and dangerous task assistance.
Evaluation scorecards verify that model risk metrics remain strictly below high/critical thresholds prior to Azure deployment.

implemented-requirements.description: Transmission confidentiality and integrity is guaranteed via TLS 1.3 / TLS 1.2 with FIPS 140-2 validated cipher suites across Azure Private Link connections, with unencrypted HTTP disabled.

values: FIPS 140-2 validated TLS 1.3 / TLS 1.2 cryptographic sessions with AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 cipher suites

statements.description: All network transmissions between clients and the Azure OpenAI GPT-4o service endpoint are encrypted in transit using FIPS-validated TLS 1.3/1.2 protocols.

implemented-requirements.description: Multi-stage input validation validates API payload structure against OpenAPI schemas, validates UTF-8 text formatting, and deploys Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields to detect and block prompt injection, delimiter hijacking, and jailbreaks.

values: user chat completion prompts, system instructions, function-calling tool schemas, JSON mode structured outputs, and base64/URL image and audio payloads

statements.description: Input validation is enforced at both the API gateway (structural schema, character set, payload size) and semantic safety layer (Prompt Shields for direct and indirect prompt injection attacks) before inference execution.
